skills.description: Through fixed enclosure cameras, the system analyzes behavior videos of reptiles (lizards, snakes, turtles) and detects movement frequency and dwell duration between the basking zone (heated area under the basking lamp) and the hiding zone (cave/cool side). It counts hourly transitions and per-zone dwell ratios, and outputs a thermal preference label (e.g. 'basking-preferred', 'hiding-preferred', 'frequent shuttling'). This skill helps assess whether the environmental temperature gradient is appropriate, infers pet health state (such as abnormal lethargy or stress reaction), and guides keepers to adjust heating layout. Application scenarios: vivariums, breeding tanks, reptile farms. The system monitors continuously, generates daily thermal-zone utilization reports, and pushes reminders when abnormalities occur. Skill features: reptiles are ectotherms that regulate body temperature through behavior. Long-term deviation from normal zone-utilization patterns (e.g. constantly hiding) may indicate disease, parasites, or environmental inadequacy. AI-based automatic monitoring helps keepers catch problems early, optimize setup, and improve animal welfare. This skill can be integrated into smart vivarium cameras or reptile-keeping apps. | 通过爬宠箱固定摄像头，分析爬行动物（如蜥蜴、蛇、龟）的行为视频，检测宠物在晒点（加热灯下方高温区域）与躲避区（洞穴、冷区）之间的移动频次、停留时长以及活动节律。统计单位时间内（如每小时）的移动次数和各温区的停留时长比例，输出温区偏好（如'偏好晒点''偏好躲避''频繁穿梭'）。该技能有助于评估环境温度是否适宜，判断宠物健康状态（如异常嗜睡、应激反应），指导饲养者调整加热设备布局。应用场景：爬宠箱、饲养缸、爬行动物养殖场。系统连续监测，生成每日温区利用报告，异常时推送提醒。技能特点：爬行动物是变温动物，需要通过行为调节体温。长期偏离正常温区利用模式（如总躲在躲避区）可能提示疾病、寄生虫或环境不适。通过 AI 自动监测，可帮助饲养者及早发现问题，优化环境设置，提升宠物福利。该技能可集成到智能爬宠箱摄像头或爬宠管理 APP 中。

skills.description:
Complete fitness training management with OPDCA methodology.
Use when the user:
(0) Says "生成训练计划", "创建健身方案", "制定训练计划" — act as a professional fitness coach,
use the OPDCA system to ask structured questions about goals/body/timeline/frequency,
then generate a personalized fitness.json from fitness_template.json.
(1) Says "运动打卡", "开始训练", "workout check-in" — determine today's workout from fitness.json,
check calendar, create calendar events for the week if missing, write exercises as tasks,
and pre-populate a Bitable record for today's training.
(2) Says "训练完成", "打卡完成", "workout done", marks tasks complete — search completed tasks,
read each task's comments via Task v1 API to extract actual weight/reps/difficulty data,
write full weight/reps data to Bitable (训练记录) for historical tracking,
then generate a daily analysis report as a Feishu Drive Markdown doc with suggestions.
(3) Asks about today's training plan, nutrition, or weekly schedule.
skills.description_zh: Corgi Exercise Expert 是一个为 AI 编程助手（如 WorkBuddy、Claude Code、OpenClaw 等）设计的 **Skill/插件**，让 AI 变身为你的专属健身教练。从方案制定、每日打卡、训练数据分析到营养管理，覆盖健身训练的完整闭环。
skills.name: Exercise Expert
